messages:
jess: Quick Friday poll — team snack/dessert? Vote with emoji or reply: :cupcake: cupcakes, :cookie: cookies, :ice_cream: ice cream, :green_apple: fruit (or write-in). I will pick up whatever wins :grin:
mark: :cookie: all the way
priya: cupcakes please! small ones so I can try 3 flavors :chef:
ken: ice cream vote — I can bring cones and sprinkles 
elena: can we add donuts as a write-in? :thinking:
katie: vegan option? if ice cream wins I can bring coconut milk pints
lunch-bot: Poll updated: cupcakes(1), cookies(1), ice cream(1), fruit(0), write-ins: donuts(1)
jess: ok noted — if write-in gets more than 2 votes I'll add donuts as a bonus. Feel free to change your vote by posting a new emoji
mark: switching to :ice_cream: if katie can bring vegan pints :raised_hands:
priya: I'll take :cupcake: still, but donuts would be a good backup
ken: love the sprinkles plan :drooling_face:
elena: donuts for the win? putting my second vote for donuts (write-in)
jess: final tally in 20m, I'll place the order for what's most popular. Thanks folks! :tada:
